_comment: Copy this file to admin-config.json (gitignored) and edit. These settings drive the `box` and `git` admin groups + the Trains/Box GUI panel. Anything you omit falls back to the documented defaults in admin.py (ADMIN_CONFIG_DEFAULTS).
_local_comment: On YOUR PC: the sorting corpus + calibration output. Windows defaults to C:\horn\*; edit to taste.
_python_comment: A Python that has librosa/scipy/numpy (the calibration env from HORN-CORPUS-GUIDE step c). Point it at your venv so `box calibrate` works.
